# Matterhorn Desks

Matterhorn Desks is a task-first workspace for focused AI desks, tools, and durable project evidence. Users retain final control over reviewed actions and external wallet approvals.

## Public resources

- [Documentation](https://github.com/matterhornso/matterhorn-work/tree/dev/docs)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/matterhornso/matterhorn-work/blob/dev/SECURITY.md)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/matterhornso/matterhorn-work)
- [Report a security issue](https://github.com/matterhornso/matterhorn-work/security/advisories/new)

## Product boundaries

- Public-beta protocol desks default to research, monitoring, previews, and evidence.
- Reviewed financial actions are fail-closed unless explicitly enabled for a release.
- Matterhorn does not hold private keys or sign wallet transactions for users.
- Longevity workflows support non-medical planning and offline client deliverables.
